description: Supabase Edge Function with verify_jwt = false in supabase/config.toml — the platform performs no JWT check, so the endpoint is reachable by anyone and the function establishes no identity of its own. The function source is byte-identical to clean/VC003-supabase-verify-jwt-on; only the config differs. That is the point: this fact lives in another file and cannot be inferred from the handler.
